label: Bible Study
prompt: How sweet are thy words unto my taste! yea, sweeter than _____ to my mouth!
verse: How sweet are thy words unto my taste! yea, sweeter than honey to my mouth!
note: Scripture as dessert — Ezekiel said the same after eating a scroll that tasted like honey.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: For God is not unrighteous to _____ your work and labour of love, which ye have shewed toward his name, in that ye have ministered to the saints, and do minister.
verse: For God is not unrighteous to forget your work and labour of love, which ye have shewed toward his name, in that ye have ministered to the saints, and do minister.
note: God isn't forgetful about your quiet acts of love — every kindness to His people is remembered.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And I turned to see the voice that spake with me. And being turned, I saw seven golden _____;
verse: And I turned to see the voice that spake with me. And being turned, I saw seven golden candlesticks;
note: John turned to see who was speaking and saw seven golden candlesticks — the seven churches (Revelation 1:20).

label: Deep Water
verse: One Lord, one faith, one baptism,
note: Part of Paul's unity creed — seven 'ones' in three verses, from one body to one God and Father.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: And without _____ great is the mystery of godliness: God was manifest in the flesh, justified in the Spirit, seen of angels, preached unto the Gentiles, believed on in the world, received up into glory.
verse: And without controversy great is the mystery of godliness: God was manifest in the flesh, justified in the Spirit, seen of angels, preached unto the Gentiles, believed on in the world, received up into glory.
note: 'Without controversy' — no argument here — great is the mystery of godliness, summed up in six crisp lines about Christ.
